### 8–16s — CO11-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · PERIMETER — What exactly is in the deal?. Inventory entity interests and each asset class with current owner, custodian, governing record, restriction, liability, and desired treatment. Do not infer asset ownership from brand presentation.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CO11-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · TRANSFER — What mechanism moves each asset?. Distinguish equity sale, asset sale, trademark assignment, copyright transfer, license, loan, deposit, donation, data transfer, and services or transition arrangement.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CO11-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · ARCHIVE — What must remain connected?. Map originals and copies, provenance, restrictions, operational dependencies, privacy, legal hold, contributor access, research terms, correction, and future interpretation.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CO11-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · AFTER — Who can use and explain the history?. Define access, digitization, exhibition, licensing, publication, brand reference, authentication, enforcement cooperation, funding, custody, and dispute mechanisms.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
